findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_nonprofits, start_connect_profile · Private data: get_foundation_grants, search_open_grants, search_nonprofits, get_organization_profile, find_funders_of_nonprofit, get_funder_stats, start_kindora_profile, start_connect_profile · Public sink: get_foundation_grants, start_kindora_profile, start_connect_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_nonprofits, start_connect_profile · Private data: get_foundation_grants, search_open_grants, search_nonprofits, get_organization_profile, find_funders_of_nonprofit, get_funder_stats, start_kindora_profile, start_connect_profile · Public sink: get_foundation_grants, start_kindora_profile, start_connect_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_connect_profile" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
